Screen Recording-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Screen-capture marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general Photos album or MDM guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Screen Recording permission claims:

屏幕录制 vs 屏幕录制权限 vs 录屏权限

US pages say "Screen Recording", "Grant Screen Recording access", or "Enable screen capture in System Settings." China storefront copy often uses 屏幕录制 for general Screen Recording positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, 屏幕录制权限 when the hero frame shows the permission rationale or access scope, and 录屏权限 when English source uses shorter capture-permission phrasing on meeting or streaming buyer frames. AppLocale picks commerce-idiomatic phrasing per frame — not 屏幕录制相簿 on consumer Screen Recording screenshots, not 隐私偏好策略控制 on grant-toggle walkthroughs, and not 完全磁盘访问 on meeting-recording onboarding.

Screen Recording vs Screen Recordings plural

Consumer Screen Recording (屏幕录制权限) lets end users toggle per-app screen-capture grants in System Settings after consent. Screen Recordings plural (屏幕录制相簿) is the Photos album where Control Center capture videos land on device. English shares "Screen Recording" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate consumer 屏幕录制 permission panels with Photos 屏幕录像 album grids. Screen Recordings plural frames belong on the Screen Recordings listing guide when saved capture-video library organization leads — not mixed into consumer Screen Recording captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Screen Recording vs PPPC

Consumer Screen Recording (屏幕录制) lets end users toggle per-app screen-capture grants in System Settings after consent. PPPC (隐私偏好策略控制) lets IT admins deploy PrivacyPreferencesPolicyControl payloads that pre-grant or deny Screen Recording for named apps on enrolled Macs. English shares "Screen Recording" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate consumer 屏幕录制 grant panels with enterprise PPPC TCC payload editors. PPPC frames belong on the PPPC listing guide when MDM TCC grants lead — not mixed into consumer Screen Recording captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Screen Recording vs Full Disk Access and App Privacy Report

Screen Recording permission governs display capture grants — 屏幕录制. Full Disk Access governs broad file-system access beyond the sandbox — 完全磁盘访问. App Privacy Report shows historical network and sensor access — 隐私报告. A Screen Recording grant toggle is not an FDA file-access panel and not an access timeline chart. Full Disk Access frames belong on the Full Disk Access listing guide; App Privacy Report frames belong on the App Privacy Report listing guide when those features lead.
